title: NeXTSTEP Release 3 Demo
summary: Steve Jobs demos NeXTSTEP Release 3, showing the object-oriented development environment and UI that later became the basis of Mac OS X. Midway through he builds a database-backed GUI app with Interface Builder and Enterprise Objects Framework with almost no code.
why: HN uses it as the classic example of rapid visual app building and of a polished early Jobs presentation, often with timestamps pointing to the database demo.

quote.text: There's a video of steve jobs building a fairly complex DB app without a single line of code, including joins.
